name: rosetta-engel-expansion
code:
use default
use System.Numerics.INumber
use System.Numerics.IMultiplyOperators.`*

power[T: INumber[T]](base: T, exponent: int) -> T =>
    if exponent == 0 then
        T.one
    elif exponent % 2 == 0 then
        let root = power(base, exponent / 2)

        root * root
    else
        base * power(base, exponent - 1)
    fi

engel(numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint) -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let current mut = numerator

    while current > 0n do
        let term = (denominator + current - 1n) / current

        yield term
        current = term * current - denominator
    od
si

from_engel(terms: Collections.List[bigint])
        -> (numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint) is
    let numerator mut = 0n
    let denominator mut = 1n

    for term in terms do
        numerator = numerator * term + 1n
        denominator = denominator * term
    od

    return (numerator, denominator)
si

show(name: string, fractional: string) is
    let numerator = bigint.parse(fractional)
    let denominator = power(10n, fractional.length)
    let terms = numerator |> engel(denominator) |> collect_list()
    let (rebuilt, scale) = from_engel(terms)
    let verified = if rebuilt * denominator =~ numerator * scale
        then "round trips" else "DOES NOT ROUND TRIP" fi
    let shown = LIST()

    for term in terms |> take(30) do
        shown.add("{term}")
    od

    write_line("{name}: {terms.count} terms, {verified}")
    write_line("  {shown |> join(" ")}")
si
